## Scope

## Authority

List accepted ADRs, OpenAPI operations, public standards, and repository issues used.

## Verification

List commands, tests, migration checks, accessibility checks, and failure scenarios.

## Impact

Describe security, privacy, data portability, localization, accessibility, self-hosting, migration, rollback, and operator impact.

## Provenance checklist

- [ ] All inputs are from this repository, cited public standards, or public upstream dependency documentation.
- [ ] Copied, adapted, and generated material is disclosed with source and license.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic and contain no real personal or family data.
- [ ] No inaccessible or non-public material shaped this change.
- [ ] The change matches accepted ADRs and the OpenAPI contract, or includes the required focused ADR update.
